pages.text: A framed chest has 27 slots and a front label based on its contents. Apply a material at the $(l:bibliocraft:materials/framing)Furniture Paneler$(/l). Set two chests side by side with their fronts aligned to make a double chest.
Blank framed chests can be used immediately or customized first.

pages.title: Join and Separate
pages.text: Sneak-drill two aligned chests to join them into 54 slots. Repeat to split them. Each half keeps its material and contents. Drill normally to split and rotate the clicked half. Lock either half to protect both.
